description: Read-only current service capabilities. In staff_review mode use review_services for availability and requests awaiting staff approval; these are not directly bookable services. Explain supported services plainly. For a request outside scope preserve its intent and offer staff transfer rather than suggesting an unrelated examination.

request_body_schema.description: Send optional purpose=capabilities_check. Read booking_mode, review_services, handoff_services and voice_answer_cs from the current response. Never promise a confirmed booking based on capabilities.

purpose.description: Konstantni nefunkcni pole jen kvuli validaci ElevenLabs schema. Backend ho ignoruje.
